title: EmbryoNet links statins to FGF-like zebrafish developmental effects
summary: A learned embryo-image classifier flagged statin-treated zebrafish as resembling reduced FGF signaling. Follow-up morphology and pERK measurements supported the developmental-pathway association. The mechanism remains proposed, and the zebrafish assays do not establish effects in human pregnancy or clinical use.
organization: University of Konstanz; Friedrich Miescher Laboratory of the Max Planck Society

evidence.tested: Embryonic morphology and pathway-associated fluorescence were measured.
evidence.unknown: Causal mechanism and human relevance were not established.
evidence.ai_role: EmbryoNet deep image classifier supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary publisher experimental Results and PDF passages; primary PubMed date and affiliations. Direct full-text retrieval blocked.
